subject: MAP + dataset handoff cadence — Spectra Retail pilot
messages:
From: Ola Smith <ola.smith@spectra-retail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Chen <paul.chen@spec-legal.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Spectra pilot — dataset exchange + MAP request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the staging options. We are ready to move forward with the pilot but need to lock the mutual action plan and the mechanics for exchanging our evaluation materials (prompt packs, testcases, and a small dataset).

Before we ship anything, can you confirm:
- A high-level MAP / timeline that gets us to a pilot close within two weeks (target Nov 24)
- How Redwood expects to receive the dataset and prompt pack (S3 link, encrypted zip?) and what manifest/checksum format you need
- The usage constraints Redwood requires (retention, training prohibition, redistribution rules) so our legal can sign off

I've attached a short requirements doc that calls out the sample size and redaction needs. Paul (cc'd) will review legal points but asked me to get a technical/ops plan in parallel.

Can you propose a draft MAP today or tomorrow? Our procurement run is tight — there is a PO ready once legal and the MAP are agreed.

Best,
Ola Smith
Head of Data Partnerships
Spectra Retail

Attachment: Spectra-Pilot-Requirements.pdf (PDF, 180 KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ola Smith <ola.smith@spectra-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Paul Chen <paul.chen@spec-legal.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Spectra pilot — dataset exchange + MAP request

Hi Ola — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the requirements doc. High level yes: we can support a two-week runway to Nov 24 if we start ingestion and access sequencing this week.

I attached a draft MAP (MAP-Spectra-20261111-draft.pdf) that outlines milestones, owners, and acceptance gates. Key points here:
- Deliverables from Spectra: prompt pack (zipped), testcase index CSV, one ephemeral dataset bundle (S3 link or encrypted SFTP). We prefer encrypted zip with a manifest + SHA256 checksum.
- Redwood deliverables: ephemeral sandbox credentials, tokenized usage reporting, acceptance gateway (QA pass on 500 sample testcases), and a takedown schedule.
- Usage constraints we require (we suggest these to be in the MAP):
  * No model training on raw materials (allowed: inference-only evaluation)
  * No redistribution outside Spectra and designated Redwood test accounts
  * Retention: Redwood to hold materials for 90 days post-close unless otherwise requested
  * Audit logs and access records provided upon request

If Paul needs different wording on retention/training clauses we can adjust — ttls and explicit redaction steps are easy to tweak.

Marissa & Karthik — looping you both to confirm the ingestion manifest format and provisioning cadence. Marissa, can your team accept the sample manifest style Ola sent? Karthik, can infra spin up ephemeral lanes once we have a signed MAP and PO?

Ola — once you ACK the MAP we will:
1) Open a HubSpot deal activity and upload the final MAP/SOW
2) Create a sandbox project and pre-provision a lane (default: p3-like instance, 32GB KV cache)
3) Share upload details and checksum template

Thanks — I can hop on a 20-min call today if you prefer to walk the timeline.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-Spectra-20261111-draft.pdf (PDF, draft)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Spectra pilot — dataset exchange + MAP request (internal sequencing)

Hannah / Karthik — quick ops checklist so we stay on the two-week runway:

1) Ingest manifest: spectra_promptpack_manifest.csv (need columns: filename, sha256, record_count, redaction_level) — ask Ola to provide one row per file.
2) Promptpack handling: we keep promptpack in ephemeral S3 bucket with access tokens rotated per sprint; promptpack should be zipped and encrypted (AES-256).
3) Testcases: we'll run the 500-sample QA sweep first and produce a regression baseline. Please confirm whether Spectra expects us to store testcases post-QA (I recommend delete after 90 days unless legal asks for longer).
4) Redaction: if any PII remains, we'll request a shorter handback window and provide redaction logs.

Attachments I will upload as stubs to the sandbox:
- spectra_promptpack_manifest.csv (template)
- ingestion-checklist.md (ops steps)

Karthik — can you prepare the infra notes about ephemeral lanes and any rate-limit defaults? If we can pre-seed the lane on Friday we can accept uploads early next week.

—Marissa
Sr. Program Manager, Onboarding
Redwood Inference

(Attachment: spectra_promptpack_manifest.csv — template)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Spectra pilot — infra provisioning + tokenization notes

Thanks — infrastructure can meet the schedule. A few technical notes to include in the MAP:

- Provisioning: ephemeral "lane" will be a pre-warmed dedicated instance (32GB KV, 8 concurrent workers). We will provide a signed URL for upload into a secured bucket; prefer encrypted zip with provided public-key.
- Access controls: scoped tokens for Spectra test accounts, rotation every 48 hours during the active window.
- Data handling: we will mount dataset read-only for inference; no persistence to long-term object store outside the sandbox.
- QA hook: provide a webhook to collect testcase results; Redwood will run baseline and return a CSV of outcome metrics.
- Performance suggestion: if average prompt length > 1,200 tokens please tell us so we can tune batching/kv-cache sizes — otherwise defaults are fine.

I've attached a short provisioning notes stub (redwood-infra-provisioning-notes.md) and will sync with Marissa for exact parameter names. For MAP cadence I recommend:
- Nov 11: Draft MAP (done)
- Nov 12–16: Ingestion + QA sweep
- Nov 17–20: Pilot evaluation window
- Nov 23: Acceptance QA complete
- Nov 24: Target close / PO execution

If Spectra wants longer retention we can extend but need an explicit clause in the MAP (default 90 days).

—Karthik
Principal Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-infra-provisioning-notes.md

From: Ola Smith <ola.smith@spectra-retail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Chen <paul.chen@spec-legal.com>, CTAM Team <ctam@spectra-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + dataset handoff cadence — Spectra Retail pilot

Hannah — thanks, this looks good and pragmatic. Paul and I reviewed the draft MAP; one asks for a small change on retention: we prefer 120 days rather than 90. If Redwood accepts 120 days and a non-training clause (as written), we can sign quickly and issue the PO (attached).

Next steps from our side:
- We'll upload the encrypted promptpack + manifest by EOD tomorrow to the signed URL you provide
- Paul will do a short redline to the MAP (if any) and return it by Thursday
- Procurement will issue the PO once MAP is final

Please send the final MAP and SOW with the retention updated to 120 days and we will route it for signature. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Ola
Head of Data Partnerships
Spectra Retail

Attachment: PO-12345.pdf (Purchase Order, stub)
